title: Denmark and John Darville
summary: His last Danish stay was two months with sponsor John Darville, a wealthy manufacturer.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How did the people, you know, receive - the last time you were in Europe in 1962, how did they like you and the band?
He didn't go with the band, darling, he went by himself.
No, I went with Sam Price.
How long did you stay then?
The last time he stayed two months.
... He's a personal friend of his, John Darville.
A manufacturer, very wealthy young man.
He does it on the side, 'cause I talked to him. He called me -
Did I show you his picture?
He called us on the telephone.
The one I was showing you last night.
His picture's right on the dresser.
